name: supporting-probes
description: Standalone sandbox probes validating hydration/serialization behavior across ORMs

scripts.probe:prisma: prisma db push --schema=prisma/schema.prisma --skip-generate && prisma generate --schema=prisma/schema.prisma && tsx prisma-test.ts
scripts.probe:all: npm run probe:typeorm && npm run probe:typeorm-positive && npm run probe:sequelize && npm run probe:mikroorm && npm run probe:prisma
